style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.speaker: Alex Zhavoronkov
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and CEO of Insilico Medicine
briefs.current_title: 英矽智能创始人：AI衰老时钟，让药物逆转衰老成为可能
current_title_lines: AI衰老时钟预测生物年龄
药物逆转衰老3-6年，抗衰老新突破？

subtitles.zh: 我们构建了自己的算法，可以预测你的生物年龄。所以你有两个年龄。
subtitles.en: we built our own algorithm which predicts your biological age. So you have two ages.

subtitles.zh: 一个是你的实际年龄，也就是护照上的年龄；另一个是生物年龄，它大致决定了你可能的寿命。
subtitles.en: One is your chronological age, the age in your passport, and your biological age, which kind of defines when you're likely to die.

subtitles.zh: 同时，生物年龄还与许多其他生物和生理过程相关。因此，我们使用了自研的“衰老时钟”。
subtitles.en: And also is correlated with many other biological processes and physiological processes. So we used our own what we call aging clock

subtitles.zh: 以及来自哈佛、北京大学、康涅狄格大学等前沿实验室的五个独立开发的蛋白质组衰老时钟。
subtitles.en: and also five other independently developed proteomic aging clocks from frontier labs at Harvard, Beijing University at University of Connecticut.

subtitles.zh: 全球科学家已发表并开发了这些衰老生物标志物，让我们不必再等待患者离世。
subtitles.en: So around the world, scientists have published and developed those biomarkers of aging that now allow us to basically instead of waiting for patients to die

subtitles.zh: 来观察我们延长了多少寿命，因为那可能需要很长时间。现在，你可以利用衰老时钟进行临床试验。
subtitles.en: and see how long did we add to their lifespan because that could be a very long time. You can now conduct clinical trials using aging clocks

subtitles.zh: 从而判断你的药物是否逆转了生物年龄。在这项研究中，所有六个时钟——包括我们自己的一个
subtitles.en: and get some sense of direction, whether your drug is reversing biological age or not. And in this study, all of six clocks, one of ours

subtitles.zh: 以及五个独立开发的时钟——都一致认为该药物将生物年龄逆转了3到6年，这是一个
subtitles.en: and five independently developed ones, agreed that the drug has reversed biological age anywhere from three to six years, which

subtitles.zh: 相当可观的数字，因为对照组（未服用该药物的患者）没有看到效果。
subtitles.en: is a very considerable number considering that the placebo, the patients that were not on the drug, they have not seen an effect.

subtitles.zh: 这给了我们非常有希望的信号，表明该药物在抗衰老方面有效。
subtitles.en: So now it gives us very promising signal that the drug is working in aging.

subtitles.en: What is important about this drug and about in silicao in general is that most of our drugs, including this one, are discovered using aging research.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们不是先考虑疾病，而是先考虑衰老——这个地球上每个人都经历的过程，包括你和我。
subtitles.en: So instead of thinking about the disease first, we think about aging, the process that everybody on the planet has, including you and I,

subtitles.zh: 衰老可能是我最大的问题，也可能是你最大的问题。所以我们试图针对这一过程，然后将药物用于疾病治疗，
subtitles.en: and as probably my biggest problem and potentially your biggest problem. So we try to target that process and then purpose the drug towards the disease, where

subtitles.zh: 我们可以在疾病中测试干预效果。特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种影响老年人的慢性病，平均发病年龄约为65岁。
subtitles.en: we can potentially test the intervention. And IPF is a chronic disease that affects the elderly. So the average age of onset is about 65.

subtitles.zh: 在这项研究中，除了衰老时钟，我们还测量了用力肺活量，这是衡量肺功能的一种方式，
subtitles.en: And we've measured forced valve capacity in this particular study, in addition to aging clocks, of course, which is kind of the way to measure long function

subtitles.zh: 即你能从肺中呼出多少空气。在65岁以下的正常人中，肺功能也会下降，通常每年下降20至50毫升。

subtitles.zh: 而IPF患者可能高达400毫升。在这里，我们首次证明，我们有可能逆转用力肺活量的下降，这是一个非常有希望的趋势。
subtitles.en: In IPF patients, it could be up to 400 milliliters. So here we first demonstrated that we can potentially very promising trend, reverse the forced valve capacity

subtitles.zh: 实际上增加了98毫升。现在我们证明衰老时钟也在逆转，这是非常有希望的趋势。现在我们可以说，整个“衰老优先”的理念——从发现到利用衰老时钟进行临床试验——是有希望的。
subtitles.en: decline actually increased it to 98 milliliters. And now we demonstrate that the aging clocks are also taking backwards, which is very promising trend. And now we can basically say that this entire philosophy, aging first discovery to clini

subtitles.en: And we are of course continuing to collect this proteomic data to be able to see if it also can sustain the effect on the age. So if it sustains, it might take a couple or maybe even more years for the study to conclude. We will see if it w

subtitles.zh: 我们可以尝试扩大适应症。首先，我们需要遵循类似GLP-1药物的模式。GLP-1药物现在是药物界的“卡戴珊”，对吧？

subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们有很多机会来证明其有效性。这种“衰老优先”的理念是可行的。如果地球上的每个人都是潜在患者，市场将是巨大的。

subtitles.en: because we've reached phase three ourselves on such a timeframe on such a budget. And we have many, many more drugs to fall onto if something doesn't work. But it's very promising.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

briefs.speaker: Jason Salar
briefs.speaker_context: Global President, International Health at Sigma (Cigna)
briefs.current_title: 信诺国际总裁：全球医疗成本飙升，大湾区成新机遇

subtitles.zh: 首先，很高兴回来。我在香港生活和工作了超过15年，所以一直很珍惜回来的机会。
subtitles.en: Yeah, well, first of all, it is great to be back. I lived and worked in Hong Kong for 15 plus years, so always appreciate the opportunities to come back.

subtitles.zh: 这次回来待两天半左右，和团队一起探讨未来的增长计划。
subtitles.en: And spending some time with the team, I'm here for just over two and a half days, understanding what the growth plans are for the future.

subtitles.zh: 显然，我们在亚洲看到了很多机会。这次也有机会会见一些客户和合作伙伴，但最重要的是和团队在一起。
subtitles.en: Obviously, Asia, we see a lot of opportunities here, and really it was a great opportunity to meet some of our clients, some of the partners that we work with, but most importantly, spend time with the team.

subtitles.zh: 具体谈谈香港吧。你当年是从零开始建立这项业务的。你觉得这里的格局和人才等方面发生了哪些变化？
subtitles.en: Tell us about Hong Kong specifically. I think you kind of built this business from the ground up way back when. How do you think the landscape has changed, the talent here and everything?

subtitles.zh: 我们在香港运营超过90年，历史悠久。但我觉得疫情带来的一个积极影响是，大家越来越意识到健康的重要性。
subtitles.en: We've been operating in Hong Kong for 90 plus years, so yes, we have a long history here. But I think particularly as one of the positives that actually came out of COVID was the growing awareness with everybody about the importance of look

subtitles.zh: 作为一家全球健康服务公司，这为我们带来了巨大机遇。我们越来越看到大湾区机遇正在显现。
subtitles.en: And as a global health services company, I mean, that's great, some great opportunities for us. More and more, we're now seeing the greater bay opportunity come into play.

subtitles.zh: 但正如你之前提到的，大家最关心的问题无疑是医疗成本上升。您认为是什么推动了这一趋势？
subtitles.en: But again, top of everybody's mind, and you've touched on it earlier, is definitely rising health care costs. What do you think is driving that?

subtitles.zh: 多重因素。过去人们认为医疗通胀是美国的问题，现在已成为全球性问题。
subtitles.en: Multiple factors. I mean, everybody used to think of health care inflation as a US problem. It's now a global problem.

subtitles.zh: 在我们运营的所有市场中，医疗通胀率都是普通通胀率的数倍。
subtitles.en: In all markets we operate in, health care inflation is at a multiple of normal of inflation.

subtitles.zh: 这主要是由成本更高的新药上市推动的。人们更加关注健康，因此更频繁地就医。
subtitles.en: That's driven by basically new pharmacy drugs with higher costs coming on. People more concerned about the health, so they want to go to the doctor more frequently.

subtitles.zh: 还有人口老龄化等因素。这些都推高了医疗成本，可负担性成为大家最关心的问题。
subtitles.en: Various factors, and then you've got aging population and things like that as well. All of that is driving up, so the health care costs and affordability being a concern on top of everybody's mind.

briefs.speaker: Jason Salar
briefs.speaker_context: Global President, International Health at Sigma (Cigna)
briefs.current_title: 信诺高管：AI助力降低医疗成本，可负担性是首要任务

subtitles.zh: Jason，有什么办法可以解决这个问题吗？我们如何缓解保单成本的上升？
subtitles.en: Is there something Jason that can be done to sort of fix this? I mean, how do we mitigate the rising cost of policies?

subtitles.zh: 可负担性绝对是我们的首要任务。我们希望确保世界各地的人们都能获得负担得起的医疗服务。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so affordability is absolutely our number one priority. We want to be able to ensure that people can have access to affordable health care no matter where they are in the world.

subtitles.zh: 部分解决方案始于预防，因为预防总是胜于治疗。
subtitles.en: And part of it starts with prevention, because prevention is always better than cure.

subtitles.zh: 我们鼓励人们定期体检、保持健康生活方式。当他们发现健康问题时，我们帮助他们应对许多市场中复杂的就医环境。
subtitles.en: So encouraging people to go for regular health checkups, lead a healthy lifestyle, when they do identify that they have a health issue, us helping them navigate what often in many markets can be quite a complex environment to sort of operat

subtitles.zh: 我们会在他们的整个健康旅程中陪伴他们。再谈谈您关于可负担性的有趣观点，您认为AI能否在降低成本方面发挥作用，比如节省开支、更早发现慢性病等。
subtitles.en: And we continue to part with them throughout their health journey. Talk to us as well about then, you know, your reason, interesting point in terms of affordability, whether AI, you think can play a role in bringing down costs, I mean, in t

subtitles.zh: 当然。信诺正在整个组织中拥抱AI。
subtitles.en: Absolutely. I mean, Signal is embracing AI at every part of the organization.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为AI提供了巨大机会，帮助客户应对复杂环境，使我们能够根据他们的需求提供个性化解决方案，并更有效地交付。
subtitles.en: We see it provides a great opportunity to help customers navigate what is often a complex environment, enables us to personalize solutions to them, to their needs, deliver them more effectively,

subtitles.zh: 这反过来也有助于解决我们刚才讨论的一些可负担性问题。
subtitles.en: which in turn helps address some of that affordability issues that we were just talking about as well.

briefs.current_title: 信诺高管：跨境就医成大湾区新趋势，成本可降30-40%
current_title_lines: 跨境就医成大湾区新趋势

subtitles.zh: 是的，绝对。由于可负担性问题，我们现在看到一个有趣的趋势：人们开始跨境寻求医疗服务。
subtitles.en: Yeah, absolutely. And a really interesting trend that we're now seeing, driven by some of the affordability issues, is that people are now going across the border to seek health care.

subtitles.zh: 我的一位同事说，他会跨境去做牙科检查，开车只需45分钟。
subtitles.en: One of my colleagues said that he goes through his dental checks across the border. It's a 45-minute drive.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为这是一个巨大的机会。我们正在与中国内地服务商加强合作，而且我们在中国有自己的合资公司，已经深耕23年。
subtitles.en: So we see that as a great opportunity. We're doing more to partner with providers in China. We also have our own joint venture in China. We've been in China 23 years.

subtitles.zh: 我们可以利用他们的合作伙伴关系。我在香港生活工作多年，现在看到的最大变化之一就是这种流动性正在成为现实。
subtitles.en: There's the opportunity to leverage the partnerships and the relationships that they have. So having lived and worked in Hong Kong for many years, that's probably one of the biggest changes I'm now seeing is this whole mobility is real.

subtitles.zh: 多年来人们一直在谈论，现在我们真的看到它发生了。请再谈谈这在实践中如何运作，以及您之前提到的AI可能带来的成本节省。
subtitles.en: It was something that was talked about for many years but we're actually seeing it happening there. Talk to us a bit more about how that would work in practice and also to your earlier point about the focus on affordability and cost savings

subtitles.zh: 您能否给出一些数字，说明这将如何重塑像信诺这样的公司未来的格局？

current_title_lines: 老龄化与健康意识提升

subtitles.zh: 我认为，从基本面来看，人口老龄化、慢性病增加，以及我之前提到的健康意识的提升，
subtitles.en: I think if you look at the fundamentals here, the aging population, growing chronic diseases, and as I said earlier, just growing awareness about the importance of keeping healthy,

subtitles.zh: 我们相信这里蕴藏着巨大的增长机遇。再加上我们在香港和中国内地的悠久历史，作为一家全球健康服务公司，我们对未来感到非常兴奋。
subtitles.en: we believe that there's a immense opportunity for growth here. Again, that combined with a long history we have both here in Hong Kong and also in China. We're really excited about what that means for us as a global health services company.

subtitles.zh: 那么，人们是否因为更健康的生活方式而减少生病？您如何看待全球范围内的健身热潮？
subtitles.en: Yeah, and are people getting sick less? Do you think because of healthier lifestyles? I mean, how do you look at this sort of fitness boom that we're seeing globally as well?

subtitles.zh: 当然，我们希望人们对自己的健康负责，定期锻炼。
subtitles.en: I mean, definitely, we want people to take responsibility for the health detailsly, exercise regularly.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，由于技术和数据的进步，我们可能比10年或15年前更早地发现疾病。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, because of the advances of technology data, we're probably picking up diseases actually earlier than we would say even 10 or 15 years ago.

subtitles.zh: 这是积极的，因为越早发现，就越有可能及早解决问题。
subtitles.en: Now, that's positive in terms of the earlier you catch something, the more likelihood you can actually address the problem early.

subtitles.zh: 但这也意味着，由于可负担性问题，实际医疗使用量会增加。
subtitles.en: But what that means is, and that's one of the things with the affordability issue, there's more actual utilization as a result of that.

subtitles.zh: Jason，你说得很有意思。今天市场对Encilico在抗衰老药物方面的进展充满热情。

subtitles.zh: 这是否意味着医疗保健的重点更多转向预防而非治疗？您如何看待这类进展？

subtitles.zh: 预防一直是我们的核心关注点。我们的使命是帮助人们改善健康和活力，希望他们健康长寿。
subtitles.en: I mean, prevention has always been a core focus for us. I mean, our mission is to help people we serve improve their health and vitality. We want them to live a long, healthy life.

subtitles.zh: 我们越来越多地看到该领域的发展。正如你提到的，甚至制药公司也在研究延长寿命、改善健康。
subtitles.en: And again, more and more you're seeing developments in that space. And as you mentioned now, even with pharmacy companies looking at improving longevity, tighter, good health.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. - words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.

6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. - Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

subtitles.zh: 出口仍然是去年中国增长的主要动力，2024、2025年贡献了超过30%的GDP增长。

subtitles.zh: 这大约占中国出口总额的三分之一。我们认为这一趋势将持续。
subtitles.en: This comes out about one-third of China's total exports. So we think this trend will continue.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

current_title_lines: AI衰老时钟预测生物年龄
药物逆转衰老3-6年，抗衰老新突破？

subtitles.zh: 我们构建了自己的算法，可以预测你的生物年龄。所以你有两个年龄。
subtitles.en: we built our own algorithm which predicts your biological age. So you have two ages.

subtitles.zh: 一个是你的实际年龄，也就是护照上的年龄；另一个是生物年龄，它大致决定了你可能的寿命。
subtitles.en: One is your chronological age, the age in your passport, and your biological age, which kind of defines when you're likely to die.

subtitles.zh: 同时，生物年龄还与许多其他生物和生理过程相关。因此，我们使用了自研的“衰老时钟”。
subtitles.en: And also is correlated with many other biological processes and physiological processes. So we used our own what we call aging clock

subtitles.zh: 以及来自哈佛、北京大学、康涅狄格大学等前沿实验室的五个独立开发的蛋白质组衰老时钟。
subtitles.en: and also five other independently developed proteomic aging clocks from frontier labs at Harvard, Beijing University at University of Connecticut.

subtitles.zh: 全球科学家已发表并开发了这些衰老生物标志物，让我们不必再等待患者离世。
subtitles.en: So around the world, scientists have published and developed those biomarkers of aging that now allow us to basically instead of waiting for patients to die

subtitles.zh: 来观察我们延长了多少寿命，因为那可能需要很长时间。现在，你可以利用衰老时钟进行临床试验。
subtitles.en: and see how long did we add to their lifespan because that could be a very long time. You can now conduct clinical trials using aging clocks

subtitles.zh: 从而判断你的药物是否逆转了生物年龄。在这项研究中，所有六个时钟——包括我们自己的一个
subtitles.en: and get some sense of direction, whether your drug is reversing biological age or not. And in this study, all of six clocks, one of ours

subtitles.zh: 以及五个独立开发的时钟——都一致认为该药物将生物年龄逆转了3到6年，这是一个
subtitles.en: and five independently developed ones, agreed that the drug has reversed biological age anywhere from three to six years, which

subtitles.zh: 相当可观的数字，因为对照组（未服用该药物的患者）没有看到效果。
subtitles.en: is a very considerable number considering that the placebo, the patients that were not on the drug, they have not seen an effect.

subtitles.zh: 这给了我们非常有希望的信号，表明该药物在抗衰老方面有效。
subtitles.en: So now it gives us very promising signal that the drug is working in aging.

subtitles.en: Well, the beauty of this drug is that it's currently in phase three. So we've taken it from very early stage from the very discovery when we discover it,

subtitles.zh: 从发现分子机制和治疗靶点，到发现人们现在可以服用的实际小分子药物，我们一路推进。
subtitles.en: the molecular mechanism and the therapeutic target and discover it, the actual small molecule that people can now take in order to try the drug.

subtitles.zh: 我们已将其推进到三期。现在，我们将在更大规模的研究中观察该药物对肺部的效果能否持续。
subtitles.en: And we've taken it all the way to phase three. So now we will see in the context of the larger study if the drug sustains its effect on the lung.

subtitles.zh: 我们当然会继续收集蛋白质组数据，以观察其对年龄的效果是否持续。如果效果持续，研究可能需要几年甚至更长时间才能结束。我们将看到它是否有效。如果有效，那就太棒了。
subtitles.en: And we are of course continuing to collect this proteomic data to be able to see if it also can sustain the effect on the age. So if it sustains, it might take a couple or maybe even more years for the study to conclude. We will see if it w

subtitles.zh: 我们可以尝试扩大适应症。首先，我们需要遵循类似GLP-1药物的模式。GLP-1药物现在是药物界的“卡戴珊”，对吧？
subtitles.en: We can try to expand the indications. So first of all, you would have to follow the very similar template as GLP1s. GLP1s are Kardashians of all drugs right now, right?

subtitles.zh: 礼来和诺和诺德为如何开发一种疾病药物、然后将其重新用于肥胖等生物状况铺平了道路。
subtitles.en: And both LLL and Nava Nordisk paved the way for how to develop a drug for a disease later repurpose it for a biological condition such as obesity.

subtitles.zh: 现在，我可以告诉你，我正在使用GLP-1药物。我用礼来的，有时也用其他品牌的。我是一个机会均等的使用者，微剂量使用。
subtitles.en: And right now, I can tell you that I am on GLP1s. I am on LLL and sometimes I'm on those antics. I'm an equal opportunity, you know, a really user on microdosing.

subtitles.zh: GLP-1药物尚未证明对衰老有效，但我确信它会的。而我们的药物根据现有数据，目前显示出非常强的效果。
subtitles.en: So that drug has not yet demonstrated the effect on aging and pretty sure it will. But our is has a very strong effect right now based on the data we see.

subtitles.zh: 当然，这还很早期。如果它获批用于某种疾病，我们或许能将其扩展至抗衰老领域。此外，英矽智能还有40多款其他药物。
subtitles.en: And again, it's very early preliminary. If it gets approved for a disease, you might be able to expand it for aging and plus at Encelico, we have 40 plus drugs in addition to this one.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们有很多机会来证明其有效性。这种“衰老优先”的理念是可行的。如果地球上的每个人都是潜在患者，市场将是巨大的。
subtitles.en: So it means that we have many shots on goal to demonstrate that it works. This philosophy works, aging first philosophy works. And then if everybody is on a planet as your patient, the market is vast.

subtitles.zh: 我们在这个角度上并不是非常受财务驱动。我们首先希望药物获批用于疾病治疗，这是最重要的方向。而抗衰老只是锦上添花。
subtitles.en: We are not actually very financially driven in this particular angle, right? So we want to approve for a disease first. That's the major important direction. But aging here is an icing on the cake.

briefs.speaker: Alex Zhavoronkov
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and CEO of Insilico Medicine
briefs.current_title: 英矽智能CEO：公司首次盈利，本人增持权益资产彰显信心
current_title_lines: 本人增持权益资产彰显信心

subtitles.zh: 我们拥有可持续的商业模式。大家看到，我们历史上首次实现盈利。AI业务和药物业务都在增长。
subtitles.en: We have a sustainable business model. You have seen that we have turned profit for the first time in our history. So both AI component and the drug component is growing off the business.

subtitles.zh: 即使这款药物可能不成功——药物研发就像赌博——但在这场赌博中，我们可能比其他大多数公司有更高的成功几率，
subtitles.en: So even if this drug, you know, may not, it's a drug, drug, drug discovery, it's a casino. But in this particular casino, we have probably higher chances of success than most other companies,

subtitles.zh: 因为我们在这样的时间和预算内自行推进到了三期。而且我们还有很多其他药物作为后备。这非常有希望。
subtitles.en: because we've reached phase three ourselves on such a timeframe on such a budget. And we have many, many more drugs to fall onto if something doesn't work. But it's very promising.

subtitles.zh: 我认为目前还没有任何药物能延长哪怕一年的寿命，无论贫富。因此，如果成功，即使延长几年，
subtitles.en: And I think that currently there is no drug that can give you even one year of life, regardless of whether you're rich or poor. So in a success here, even with a few years,

subtitles.zh: 延长寿命和健康寿命也将是举世瞩目的巨大成就。这就是我为之奋斗的目标。我几乎不在乎其他任何事情。我可以向你保证，我会继续努力。
subtitles.en: additional to your lifespan and health span would be an enormous achievement first time in the world. So that's what I live for. I actually don't care about pretty much anything else. So I can definitely guarantee you that I will continue.

subtitles.zh: 你可能已经看到我们宣布我正在增持股票。实际上，作为CEO，我必须经过许多程序，向董事会申请并通过合规审查才能这样做。
subtitles.en: You probably have seen that we made an announcement that I am buying stock right now. Actually, as a CEO, I have to go through many roadblocks and apply to your board and go through compliance to be able to do that.

subtitles.zh: 所以我开始增持，因为我认为现在，沿着这个方向，我们看起来非常有希望。
subtitles.en: So I started accumulating as well, because I think that now, with this particular direction now, we look very promising.

subtitles.zh: 您能澄清一下股票增持的情况吗？您买了多少？我们在香港发布了公告。
subtitles.en: Can you clarify about the stock buying? How much of the stock have you bought? We have made an announcement in Hong Kong.

subtitles.zh: 我们必须非常合规。我们已经宣布我将增持股票。一旦完成购买，我们会公布具体金额。目前已经增持了1600万港元。
subtitles.en: You have to be extremely compliant. And we've made an announcement that I will accumulate the stock. So once I finish buying, we will announce how much. But currently it's up to 16 million Hong Kong.

subtitles.zh: 对我而言，考虑到我拿薪水，并且之前参与了公司的融资轮次，这对我来说是一个相当大的数字。所以我是坚定的看好者。
subtitles.en: For me, considering that I'm on a salary and I've previously participated in our previous rounds, such as Rowan D, like for me, it's a considerable number. So I'm a big believer.

briefs.speaker: Jason Salar
briefs.speaker_context: Global President, International Health at Sigma (Cigna)
briefs.current_title: 信诺国际总裁：全球医疗成本飙升，大湾区成新机遇

subtitles.zh: 首先，很高兴回来。我在香港生活和工作了超过15年，所以一直很珍惜回来的机会。
subtitles.en: Yeah, well, first of all, it is great to be back. I lived and worked in Hong Kong for 15 plus years, so always appreciate the opportunities to come back.

subtitles.zh: 这次回来待两天半左右，和团队一起探讨未来的增长计划。
subtitles.en: And spending some time with the team, I'm here for just over two and a half days, understanding what the growth plans are for the future.

subtitles.zh: 显然，我们在亚洲看到了很多机会。这次也有机会会见一些客户和合作伙伴，但最重要的是和团队在一起。
subtitles.en: Obviously, Asia, we see a lot of opportunities here, and really it was a great opportunity to meet some of our clients, some of the partners that we work with, but most importantly, spend time with the team.

subtitles.zh: 具体谈谈香港吧。你当年是从零开始建立这项业务的。你觉得这里的格局和人才等方面发生了哪些变化？
subtitles.en: Tell us about Hong Kong specifically. I think you kind of built this business from the ground up way back when. How do you think the landscape has changed, the talent here and everything?

subtitles.zh: 我们在香港运营超过90年，历史悠久。但我觉得疫情带来的一个积极影响是，大家越来越意识到健康的重要性。
subtitles.en: We've been operating in Hong Kong for 90 plus years, so yes, we have a long history here. But I think particularly as one of the positives that actually came out of COVID was the growing awareness with everybody about the importance of look

subtitles.zh: 作为一家全球健康服务公司，这为我们带来了巨大机遇。我们越来越看到大湾区机遇正在显现。
subtitles.en: And as a global health services company, I mean, that's great, some great opportunities for us. More and more, we're now seeing the greater bay opportunity come into play.

subtitles.zh: 但正如你之前提到的，大家最关心的问题无疑是医疗成本上升。您认为是什么推动了这一趋势？
subtitles.en: But again, top of everybody's mind, and you've touched on it earlier, is definitely rising health care costs. What do you think is driving that?

subtitles.zh: 多重因素。过去人们认为医疗通胀是美国的问题，现在已成为全球性问题。
subtitles.en: Multiple factors. I mean, everybody used to think of health care inflation as a US problem. It's now a global problem.

subtitles.zh: 在我们运营的所有市场中，医疗通胀率都是普通通胀率的数倍。
subtitles.en: In all markets we operate in, health care inflation is at a multiple of normal of inflation.

subtitles.zh: 这主要是由成本更高的新药上市推动的。人们更加关注健康，因此更频繁地就医。
subtitles.en: That's driven by basically new pharmacy drugs with higher costs coming on. People more concerned about the health, so they want to go to the doctor more frequently.

subtitles.zh: 还有人口老龄化等因素。这些都推高了医疗成本，可负担性成为大家最关心的问题。
subtitles.en: Various factors, and then you've got aging population and things like that as well. All of that is driving up, so the health care costs and affordability being a concern on top of everybody's mind.

briefs.speaker_context: Global President, International Health at Sigma (Cigna)
briefs.current_title: 信诺高管：老龄化与健康意识提升，亚洲增长机遇巨大
current_title_lines: 老龄化与健康意识提升

subtitles.zh: 我认为，从基本面来看，人口老龄化、慢性病增加，以及我之前提到的健康意识的提升，
subtitles.en: I think if you look at the fundamentals here, the aging population, growing chronic diseases, and as I said earlier, just growing awareness about the importance of keeping healthy,

subtitles.zh: 我们相信这里蕴藏着巨大的增长机遇。再加上我们在香港和中国内地的悠久历史，作为一家全球健康服务公司，我们对未来感到非常兴奋。
subtitles.en: we believe that there's a immense opportunity for growth here. Again, that combined with a long history we have both here in Hong Kong and also in China. We're really excited about what that means for us as a global health services company.

subtitles.zh: 那么，人们是否因为更健康的生活方式而减少生病？您如何看待全球范围内的健身热潮？
subtitles.en: Yeah, and are people getting sick less? Do you think because of healthier lifestyles? I mean, how do you look at this sort of fitness boom that we're seeing globally as well?

subtitles.zh: 当然，我们希望人们对自己的健康负责，定期锻炼。
subtitles.en: I mean, definitely, we want people to take responsibility for the health detailsly, exercise regularly.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，由于技术和数据的进步，我们可能比10年或15年前更早地发现疾病。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, because of the advances of technology data, we're probably picking up diseases actually earlier than we would say even 10 or 15 years ago.

subtitles.zh: 这是积极的，因为越早发现，就越有可能及早解决问题。
subtitles.en: Now, that's positive in terms of the earlier you catch something, the more likelihood you can actually address the problem early.

subtitles.zh: 但这也意味着，由于可负担性问题，实际医疗使用量会增加。
subtitles.en: But what that means is, and that's one of the things with the affordability issue, there's more actual utilization as a result of that.

subtitles.zh: Jason，你说得很有意思。今天市场对Encilico在抗衰老药物方面的进展充满热情。
subtitles.en: Jason, that's a very interesting point you make. Also, coming on a day where there's a lot of, I suppose, enthusiasm surrounding an anti-aging drug that Encilico has made progress on.

subtitles.zh: 这是否意味着医疗保健的重点更多转向预防而非治疗？您如何看待这类进展？
subtitles.en: I mean, does this sort of shift the focus more on prevention rather than treatment when it comes to health care? I mean, how do you view something like that?

subtitles.zh: 预防一直是我们的核心关注点。我们的使命是帮助人们改善健康和活力，希望他们健康长寿。
subtitles.en: I mean, prevention has always been a core focus for us. I mean, our mission is to help people we serve improve their health and vitality. We want them to live a long, healthy life.

subtitles.zh: 我们越来越多地看到该领域的发展。正如你提到的，甚至制药公司也在研究延长寿命、改善健康。
subtitles.en: And again, more and more you're seeing developments in that space. And as you mentioned now, even with pharmacy companies looking at improving longevity, tighter, good health.

briefs.current_title: 瑞银胡一帆：出口仍是增长引擎，AI与绿色科技成主力

subtitles.zh: 出口仍然是去年中国增长的主要动力，2024、2025年贡献了超过30%的GDP增长。
subtitles.en: Yeah, exports, I think, is still the main driver of the China's growth last year. 2024, 2025, contribute over 30% of GDP growth.

subtitles.zh: 今年到目前为止是20%，但我认为会保持在20%到30%之间。我们认为这一趋势将持续，尤其是在AI和绿色科技领域。
subtitles.en: And this year, so far, it's 20%, but I think it will remain like between 20 to 30%. So we think the students will continue, especially in the AI and the green tech.

subtitles.zh: 这大约占中国出口总额的三分之一。我们认为这一趋势将持续。
subtitles.en: This comes out about one-third of China's total exports. So we think this trend will continue.
